verdicts.reason: A scatters the botanical pills into separate pieces: two tiny pills sit above the headline, and the rest are mismatched in size around the CTA. The logo is shrunk into the bottom-left corner. The 'Flavours vary by region' legal line is blown up to subhead size, and the CTA is jammed against the pills, so it reads as an unusable jumble. B has a sensible top-to-bottom flow (product, headline, CTA, logo), but it still has clear flaws: the legal line is far too large, the CTA is squeezed into the pill grid as one equal-sized cell, and the pill sizes and font weights don't match. The product also crowds the top edge.
